root: ^What did I do to deserve this?
^I have accepted every gift from the gods. Disgusting gifts, smelly gifts, even inedible. I have been forsaken!!
^Maniacal laughter* Yes! Now I will get all the gifts! Divinity is mine, finally! I am this ocean's chosen one!
^Enjoy it...whilst it lasts. Gods are fickle. You’ll be next! Next, I say!!
^I didn’t know that would happen...How could you let me hurt him!? You used me! Not very divine of you.
^Why should he get everything!? While I survive on tiny plankton I can’t even see!?
^This is terrible. Though, that leg looks kinda sharp…not like he has any use of it anymore.
